summary: Small gravel car area by the croquet club, no homes within 75 m.
reasons: Park and club on one side, offices opposite

drivers.seclusion: Park grounds behind, club building next to it; only commercial and school buildings nearby, apartments 79 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Gravel and dirt forecourt with cars parked in it; open to the road, room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Busy multi-lane inner-city road beside it; van stands clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Cars use the forecourt; no campers seen.

flags: Steep: DEM shows about 10% mean grade at the ring, though the forecourt looks flat
Club building 14 m away; users may notice a van
Several mapped gates nearby, none on the only access
sun_shade: Large tree shades the north-west side; forecourt open to afternoon sun.
cannot_judge: Whether the forecourt is reserved for members

best_section.where: Gravel forecourt beside the West End Croquet Club, just south-west of the ring, off the main road
